Name: Revenant's Crops
Author: RevenantReturn
Description:
New in v 2!
Two new crops: Gai Lan and the Twisted Tree! 
Adjusts data and art for existing crops, the art should now appear as intended.
Now requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348/]SpaceCore[/url].
[b]If you use the More Trees mod, check the comments section for install instructions.[/b]

v 1
Adds three new types of crops: Enoki Mushrooms, Maitake Mushrooms, and Oyster Mushrooms. More are planned for updates, and feel free to add suggestions!



By default, the crops are only sold after year 2 or above. If you'd prefer them to be available from year 1, download the 'without years' version.

[b]Requires SMAPI 2.5.3+ if you would like to be notified of updates![/b] To install, unzip the file and move the folder 'RevenantsMushrooms' to 'Stardew Valley/Mods/'. 
If you would prefer to install as a JsonAssets mod, move the folder to 'Stardew Valley/Mods/JsonAssets', and rename the file 'manifest.json' to 'content-pack.json.' If you have previously installed in this way and want to install the other way, any crops you currently have and items added by this mod will become bugged. Destroy the crops and items and go to sleep for a day and it should work fine. Updating will be fine as long as you use the same method of installation.
